phonics.tipJa: re ＋ make = remake（つくりなおす）。re は「もう いちど」。reuse（もう いちど つかう）・replay（もう いちど あそぶ）・redo（やりなおす）。

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to a new world. Remember the clink, clank sound? We went over the hill, and look! A big wooden door with gears on it. This is the Gadget Workshop! Let's go inside. Tick, tock, click! Look at all the machines. This machine makes toys. Say it with me. This machine makes toys. Great! What does that machine do? It makes music. ここは からくり工房。きかいが なにを するか、makes で いうよ。 Let's practice. This machine makes cookies. That machine makes bubbles. What does this machine do? It washes socks! Now, phonics. Remake. Reuse. Replay. Redo. Re means again. Make, remake. Use, reuse. Play, replay. When you see re at the start, think: one more time! This machine makes ice cream. Yum! That machine makes paper planes. Now, imagine a machine. What does your machine make? Tell me!

segments.say: Sound time! R E at the start says ree. Ree means again. Make, remake. Use, reuse. Play, replay. Do, redo.

segments.subtitleEn: Your turn. Remake. Reuse. Replay. Redo. The music stopped? Replay! The toy broke? Let's remake it!

segments.say: Let's move! Open the big door slowly. Creeeak! Now, listen. Tick, tock, click! Hand to your ear.

segments.say: Speed challenge! Turn the big wheel! Point to the machine! Open the big door slowly! Listen! Super inventors!

segments.say: What does that machine do?

segments.subtitleEn: What does that machine do?

segments.say: It makes music. Listen!

segments.say: Your turn! Imagine your own machine. This machine makes... Cookies? Bubbles? Rainbows? You decide!

segments.say: Quiz time! Which one is right? A, This machine make toys. B, This machine makes toys. Think!

segments.say: Great start, inventors! You can say what a machine does, and ask, What does it do? Next, talk with Haru! ハルくん と おはなし してね. See you in the workshop!

phonics.tipJa: re ＋ tell = retell（もう いちど はなす）。reread（よみなおす）・rewrite（かきなおす）・rebuild（くみなおす）。re の つづりは r ＋ e。

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Look at this tool shelf. There are so many tools! What's this tool? This is a pair of scissors. What's it used for? It's used for cutting paper. Say it with me. It's used for cutting paper. Nice! After used for, we say a word with i n g. Cutting, painting, opening. つかいみちは used for の あとに ing の ことばを つけるよ。 Let's practice. What's this tool? It's a hammer. It's used for hitting nails. What's this? It's a screwdriver. It's used for turning screws. Remember, tools can be dangerous. At home, always ask an adult before you use them. Now, phonics. Retell. Reread. Rewrite. Rebuild. Tell, retell. Read, reread. Write, rewrite. Build, rebuild. Re means again. What's this? It's tape. It's used for sticking things together. Now, look around your room. Find a tool. What's it used for? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Look at this machine. It's a gumball machine, but it's a gadget, too. How do you use it? Push this button. Then, turn it. Say it with me. Push this button. Then, turn it. Great! We use then to tell the next step. How do you use it? Pull this lever. Then, a ball comes out! てじゅんを いうときは、まず 動作の ことば、つぎに Then だよ。 Let's practice. How do you use a water bottle? Open the cap. Then, drink. How do you use a flashlight? Push the switch. Then, point it. Now, phonics. Refill. Reopen. Repaint. Restart. The machine is empty. Let's refill it! The game is over. Let's restart! Re means again. Pull the lever again. Another ball! Now, think of a machine at home. How do you use it? Tell me two steps!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we are fixing a toy robot. Its arm is loose. We need to make this screw tight. Watch me. Turn it to the right. Now you try. Like this? Yes, that's right! Turn it the other way. わからない ときは Like this? と きけば だいじょうぶ。 Let's practice. Fold the paper like this. Like this? Yes, that's right! Put the gear here. Is this right? Not quite. Put it a little higher. Now, phonics. Recheck. Retry. Refold. Rewind. Rewind the toy and let it go. It stopped? Retry! Re means again. Now, show me how to clap three times. Like this?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we are making a paper robot. Let's follow the steps. First, draw a line with a ruler. Next, cut along the line. Say it with me. Next, cut along the line. Super! Then, glue the two parts together. First, next, then. These words make your steps easy to follow. Next は「つぎに」。First、Next、Then の じゅんばんで いうよ。 Remember, use scissors slowly and carefully. Let's practice. How do you make a sandwich? First, get two pieces of bread. Next, put cheese on one piece. Then, put the other piece on top. Now, phonics. Eraser. Stapler. Cutter. Scanner. Erase, eraser. Staple, stapler. Cut, cutter. Scan, scanner. Look at the spelling changes. A mistake? Use an eraser. Lots of papers? Use a stapler. Now, tell me how you get ready for school. First, next, then!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we are finishing a karakuri doll. It carries a cup of tea and bows. Here are the last steps. First, put the gears in. Next, put the spring in. Then, wind it up. Finally, let go. Look! It's walking! Finally, it works! Say it with me. Finally, it works! Wonderful! Finally means the last step. It also means, at last, after a long time. Finally は「さいごに」と「やっと」の きもち。 Let's practice. First, I studied hard. Next, I practiced. Finally, I passed the test! Now, phonics. Elevator. Calculator. Projector. Motor. These words end in o r, not e r. Elevate, elevator. Calculate, calculator. Same sound, different spelling. First, I mixed the flour. Then, I baked the bread. Finally, we ate it! Now, tell me about something you finished. Finally, what?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Welcome to the How-To Show! Today, I'll show you how to make a pinwheel. Listen to the four steps. First, cut. Next, fold. Then, glue. Finally, play! Finally, put it on a stick and blow! 4つの ステップを じゅんばんの ことばで いえたら はっぴょう できるよ。 When you finish, say, Thank you for watching! Now, phonics review. Opener. Cutter. Elevator. Inventor. E r, e r, o r, o r. Practice at home first. Then, show your family. Remember to speak slowly and show each step with your hands. Now, it's your turn. Choose something easy, like making a rice ball. Tell me the four steps!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Before we use the big machines, we have a safety class. Listen carefully. You have to wear goggles. Say it with me. You have to wear goggles. Great! Goggles keep your eyes safe. You have to wear gloves, too. You have to tie back long hair. Do I have to wear gloves? Yes, you do. have to は「〜しなければ ならない」。きまりを いう ときに つかうよ。 Remember, at home you have to ask an adult before you use tools. Let's practice. At the pool, you have to wear a swim cap. In the library, you have to be quiet. Now, phonics. Wrench. Wrist. Knob. Knot. The w in w r is silent. The k in k n is silent, too. Wrench, knob. Now, tell me. What do you have to do at school?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Look at this machine. It's a small oven for metal parts. It's very hot. You must not touch it. It's hot. Say it with me. You must not touch it. It's hot. Good! You must not swim here. You must not cross the road now. The light is red. You must wait. Now, phonics. Thumb. Climb. Comb. Plumber. The b in m b is silent. Thumb. Don't say the b. lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! The workshop needs a rules poster. Let's write three rules together. What's important? We must clean up. We have to share tools. Say it with me. We must clean up. We have to share tools. Excellent! Rule number one: We must wear goggles. Rule number two: We have to share tools. Rule number three: We should help each other. Should is softer. It's good advice, not a strict rule. ルールは must や have to、アドバイスは should だよ。 Let's practice. Classroom rules. We must not run in the hallway. We have to raise our hands. We should say good morning. Now, phonics review. Wrench. Knob. Thumb. Guitar. Whistle. Silent letters are quiet, but we still write them. Three rules are easy to remember. Now, make a rule for your home. We must what?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! It's late in the workshop. Kiko is yawning. Let's give her some advice. You look tired. You should rest. Say it with me. You look tired. You should rest. Shouldn't means it's not a good idea. should は「〜した ほうが いい」。やさしい アドバイスの ことばだよ。 Let's practice. My friend has a cold. You should go to bed early. My friend is hungry. You should eat a snack. My friend plays games all night. You shouldn't do that! Now, phonics. Quick. Quiet. Quiz. Queen. Q and u are best friends. They always go together. My friend is cold. You should wear a jacket. Now, give me some advice. I'm sleepy. What should I do?

That's not fair! Let's check the rules. Good! It's OK to say it, but say it calmly. Then, explain. You moved four spaces, not three. Birimo can say, Sorry. You're right. Let's play again. It's OK. It's just a game. ずるいと おもったら、おこらずに ルールを いっしょに たしかめよう。 Let's practice. Your friend took two cookies. That's not fair! We should get equal parts. Let's check. Now, phonics. Liquid. Equal. Squeak. lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Look. This is the inventor's gallery. There are many great inventions here. This is an old telephone. The telephone helps people talk. Say it with me. The telephone helps people talk. Great! Helps people means it makes life better for people. The light bulb lights up dark rooms. The wheel helps people carry heavy things. helps people ～ で「ひとの やくに たつ」ことを いうよ。 Let's practice. The refrigerator keeps food cold. The bicycle helps people go far. The camera helps people remember special days. Remember, look with your eyes, not your hands. Now, phonics. House. Cloud. Touch. Young. In house and cloud, o u says ow. In touch and young, o u says uh. Same letters, different sounds! Now, tell me about a great invention. What does it help people do?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today, let's imagine our dream machines. Riko's machine is amazing. My machine can clean my room. Say it with me. My machine can clean my room. Great! Next, describe it. It has two long arms. It can also fold my clothes. Use can for what it does. Use has for its parts. ゆめの きかいは can で できる こと、has で かたちを いうよ。 Let's practice. My machine can cook soup. It has a big spoon. It can also wash the dishes. My machine can fly. It has four wings. It can take a group of friends to school! Any idea is OK. Dream big! Now, phonics. Soup. Group. Country. Double. In soup and group, o u says oo. In country and double, o u says uh. Now, tell me about your dream machine. What can it do?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! This is the workshop's recycling corner. There are boxes, bottle caps and old cans. Don't throw them away! We can reuse these boxes. Say it with me. We can reuse these boxes. Great! Reuse means use again. We can remake it into a toy. These bottle caps can be wheels. Remake into means make it into something new. すてる まえに、もう いちど つかえないか かんがえよう。 Let's practice. We can reuse this jar as a pencil case. We can remake old socks into puppets. This paper roll can be a telescope. Reusing things helps the Earth, too. Now, phonics. Though. Dough. Thought. Brought. In though and dough, o u g h says oh. In thought and brought, it says aw. Now, look around your house. What can you reuse? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to the World 19 Invention Show in the workshop square! The Dream Machine is ready. Let's say our big sentence. We made a dream machine together! Say it with me. We made a dream machine together! Fantastic! In this world, we learned so much. It's used for cutting paper. First, next, then, finally. You have to wear goggles. You must not touch it. You should rest. May I use this? ワールド19 の まとめ。はつめいの ことばで はっぴょうしよう。 Now, present the machine. It's used for making people smile. You can start it by turning this handle. Phonics review. Remake. Inventor. Whistle. Question. Young. Thought. Thank you, everyone. You did an amazing job! You were great inventors, and great friends, too. Now, squeeze, turn, pull, and listen. The machine is playing festival music!
